<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="activity-diagram-horizontal"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" background="transparent" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{"data": "flowchart TD
 %% Initial Start Node
 Start(( )):::startEndNode

 %% 3 Swimlanes Arranged Horizontally Across the Canvas
 subgraph Worker [\"Farm Worker\"]
 direction TB
 A[\"3.1 Record Daily Field & Animal Activities<br/>(Plots, Animals, Materials)\"]
 E[\"3.4.3 Return Rejected Submissions<br/>(Review Correction Notice & Revise Data)\"]
 end

 subgraph Sys [\"System (Inventory & Interface)\"]
 direction TB
 B[\"3.4.1 Review Worker Activity Drafts<br/>(Stage Pending Draft & Format Check)\"]
 ForkBar[\"======== FORK (Parallel Execution) ========\"]:::barNode
 F[\"3.2 Execute Automated Material Depletion<br/>(3.2.3 Post Deductions to D2: Inventory Ledger)\"]
 G[\"3.4.2 Authorize Approved Submissions<br/>(Commit Approved Record to D3: Operations Logs)\"]
 JoinBar[\"======== JOIN (Synchronization) ========\"]:::barNode
 EndNode((( ))):::startEndNode
 end

 subgraph Manager [\"Farm Manager\"]
 direction TB
 C[\"3.4 Validate Operational Submissions<br/>(Verify Quantities & Agronomic Logs)\"]
 D{\"3.4 Decision:<br/>Submission Valid?\"}
 end

 %% Workflow Routing
 Start --> A
 A -->|\"Daily activity log\"| B
 B -->|\"Pending draft for review\"| C
 C --> D

 %% Decision Branches
 D -->|\"No: Rejected\"| E
 E -->|\"Re-submit activity log to 3.1\"| A

 D -->|\"Yes: Approved\"| ForkBar

 %% Parallel Execution (Fork)
 ForkBar -->|\"Deduct consumables\"| F
 ForkBar -->|\"Commit audit log\"| G

 %% Synchronization (Join)
 F --> JoinBar
 G --> JoinBar
 JoinBar --> EndNode

 %% Styling
 classDef default fill:#f8fafc,stroke:#475569,stroke-width:2px,color:#0f172a,font-family:Recursive;
 classDef startEndNode fill:#1e293b,stroke:#1e293b,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff,font-weight:bold;
 classDef decisionNode fill:#fef08a,stroke:#ca8a04,stroke-width:2px,color:#854d0e,font-weight:bold;
 classDef barNode fill:#0f172a,stroke:#0f172a,stroke-width:3px,color:#ffffff,font-weight:bold;
 
 class D decisionNode;
 class ForkBar barNode;
 class JoinBar barNode;", "config": null, "version": "12"}" id="cell-mermaid-root"> <mxCell connectable="0" parent="1" style="group;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Lane 1: Farm Worker --> <UserObject label="Farm Worker" id="lane-worker"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="swimlane;html=1;startSize=30;horizontal=1;fillColor=#FDF4FF;strokeColor=#E879F9;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;strokeWidth=2;rounded=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="40" width="320" height="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Lane 2: System --> <UserObject label="System (Inventory & Interface)" id="lane-system"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="swimlane;html=1;startSize=30;horizontal=1;fillColor=#F0FDFA;strokeColor=#2DD4BF;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;strokeWidth=2;rounded=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="40" width="350" height="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Lane 3: Farm Manager --> <UserObject label="Farm Manager" id="lane-manager"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="swimlane;html=1;startSize=30;horizontal=1;fillColor=#FFF7ED;strokeColor=#FB923C;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;strokeWidth=2;rounded=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="40" width="310" height="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Start Node --> <UserObject label="" id="node-start"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0f172a;strokeColor=#0f172a;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="178" y="83" width="24" height="24" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Action 1: 3.1 Record Daily Field & Animal Activities --> <UserObject label="3.1 Record Daily Field & Animal Activities
(Plots, Animals, Materials)" id="node-submit-log"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="70" y="130" width="240" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Action 2: 3.4.1 Review Worker Activity Drafts --> <UserObject label="3.4.1 Review Worker Activity Drafts
& Validate Input Formats" id="node-draft-record"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="430" y="130" width="250" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Action 3: 3.4 Validate Operational Submissions --> <UserObject label="3.4 Validate Operational Submissions
& Verify Material Usage" id="node-review-submission"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="795" y="130" width="245" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Decision: 3.4 Validation Decision --> <UserObject label="3.4 Decision:
Submission
Valid?" id="node-decision"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef08a;strokeColor=#ca8a04;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#854d0e;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="847" y="230" width="140" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Action 4: 3.4.3 Return Rejected Submissions (Correction Notice) --> <UserObject label="3.4.3 Review Correction Notice
& Revise Operational Data" id="node-correction-notice"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="70" y="242.5" width="240" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- FORK BAR --> <UserObject label="" id="node-fork-bar"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#0f172a;strokeColor=#0f172a;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="415" y="370" width="280" height="8" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Parallel Action 1: 3.2 Execute Automated Material Depletion --> <UserObject label="3.2 Execute Automated
Material Depletion
(3.2.3 Deduct D2 Stock)" id="node-stock-depletion"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="390" y="430" width="160" height="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Parallel Action 2: 3.4.2 Authorize Approved Submissions --> <UserObject label="3.4.2 Authorize Approved
Submissions
(Commit to D3 Logs)" id="node-commit-log"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontFamily=Recursive;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;arcSize=20;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="560" y="430" width="160" height="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- JOIN BAR --> <UserObject label="" id="node-join-bar"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#0f172a;strokeColor=#0f172a;strokeWidth=2;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="415" y="550" width="280" height="8" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Final End Node --> <UserObject label="" id="node-end"> <mxCell parent="cell-mermaid-root" style="ellipse;html=1;shape=endState;fillColor=#0f172a;strokeColor=#0f172a;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="539" y="614" width="32" height="32" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<!-- Edges --> <UserObject label="" id="edge-start-submit"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-start" target="node-submit-log" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Daily activity log" id="edge-submit-draft"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-submit-log" target="node-draft-record" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Pending draft for review" id="edge-draft-review"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-draft-record" target="node-review-submission" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="" id="edge-review-decision"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-review-submission" target="node-decision" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="No: Rejected" id="edge-decision-rejected"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-decision" target="node-correction-notice" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Re-submit activity log to 3.1" id="edge-correction-submit"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-correction-notice" target="node-submit-log" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Yes: Approved" id="edge-decision-approved"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-decision" target="node-fork-bar" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#16a34a;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="917" y="374" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Deduct consumables" id="edge-fork-deplete"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-fork-bar" target="node-stock-depletion" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="Commit audit log" id="edge-fork-commit"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-fork-bar" target="node-commit-log" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="" id="edge-deplete-join"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-stock-depletion" target="node-join-bar" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="" id="edge-commit-join"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-commit-log" target="node-join-bar" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
<UserObject label="" id="edge-join-end"> <mxCell edge="1" parent="cell-mermaid-root" source="node-join-bar" target="node-end" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
